component.name: NEURODECK
component.summary: AI Terminal Interface for Steam Deck

description.p: NEURODECK is a Tauri-based desktop application that transforms a Steam Deck into a fullscreen AI-powered terminal OS. It combines LLM chat, a live code canvas, multi-session PTY terminal, SSH client, FTP/SFTP file browser, LAN file transfer, iPhone remote control, and gamepad-native navigation in a single 1280×800 window.

ul.li: LLM chat with RAG memory, game-context awareness, and Vision (Gemini)
Live HTML/CSS/JS canvas with Python, Bash, and Lua execution
Multi-session PTY terminal with AI autocomplete (Ctrl+Space)
SSH client with password and key-based authentication
FTP and SFTP file browser with drag-and-drop upload
LAN P2P file transfer with mDNS peer discovery (Warpinator-compatible)
iPhone remote control via WebSocket and QR pairing
Local document RAG indexing for knowledge base queries
Whisper.cpp offline STT and espeak TTS
Gamepad radial menu with 10 views (L2 trigger or backtick)
BMAD multi-agent persona system with Lua plugin support
MCP server — use NEURODECK as a tool server from Claude Desktop

screenshot.caption: NEURODECK chat interface with AI response and RAG memory

ul.li: 22 features shipped: Chat, Canvas, Terminal, SSH, FTP/SFTP, Share, Agent, Memory, Prompt Lab, Remote Control
Radial menu expanded to 10 segments (SSH and Remote added)
AI terminal autocomplete via Ctrl+Space (ghost text)
Local document RAG indexing with progress bar
iPhone remote control via WebSocket and QR pairing
FTP streaming download/upload (no OOM on large files)
Whisper.cpp offline STT support
BMAD agent framework integration
